info.title: Mint Public API
info.description: REST API for creating and managing account-owned 3D Models, Asset Packs, Worlds, Materials, Images, Audio, Videos, Animations, and their files.

tags.name: 3D Models
tags.description: Generate, read, revise, retry, optimize, retopologize, and convert 3D Models.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests allowed by the active rate-limit bucket.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Best-effort estimate of whole requests remaining in the active rate-limit bucket. A 429 response and Retry-After are authoritative.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the continuously refilling bucket is expected to be full.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional stable key for safely retrying an uncertain mutating request. Mint creates an internal key when this header is omitted. Reusing a supplied key with different parameters returns 409.

ListLimit.name: limit
ListLimit.description: Maximum number of resources to return.

ListCursor.name: cursor
ListCursor.description: Cursor returned from the previous page's pagination.nextCursor.

PaymentRequired.description: The account needs credits or an active plan for this operation.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated account or API project cannot access this operation.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, inactive, or revoked API key or OAuth access token.

Conflict.description: Idempotency key conflict or already-running request.

TooManyRequests.description: An account or traffic-class token bucket was exhausted. Authenticated traffic allows 600 requests per minute; paid work and conversions each allow 30 starts per minute. Limits refill continuously and are shared across an account's API keys.

NotFound.description: The requested API resource was not found.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Mint could not reach the backend service.

ContentPolicyBlocked.description: The safety check completed and blocked the content.

ContentSafetyUnavailable.description: Mint could not complete the safety check. The request was not processed and may be retried.

ServerError.description: The operation failed to start or transition.

conversationId.description: Optional owned Modeler session. Revisions inherit their parent session when omitted.

type.description: Stable URI identifying the error category.

status.description: HTTP status code for this error.

instance.description: Request path or identifier for this occurrence.

errors.description: Machine-readable field issues included for request validation failures.

operationId.description: Blocked operation that can be polled and resumed after billing is resolved.

billing.description: The billing action required before this operation can continue.

actionUrl.description: Platform billing URL where the developer can add Credits or subscribe.

code.description: Stable validation category supplied by the request schema.

PricingEstimateRequest.description: Strict operation-discriminated pricing input. Each operation accepts only factors that can affect its planned Credit reservations.

PricingEstimate.description: Advisory conservative Credit reservations for one normalized public API request.

operation.description: Public operation discriminator copied from the request.

credits.description: Credits needed to start and the conservative planned total.

requiredToStart.description: Credits planned for the first non-conditional stage.

estimatedTotal.description: Conservative sum of all planned stages, including conditional stages.

stages.description: Planned reservation stages in execution order.

conditional.description: Whether starting this stage requires a later lifecycle decision.

pricingFactors.description: Normalized public inputs used by pricing, including defaults and resolved resource configuration.

prompt.description: Describe the World Mint should create.

name.description: Optional World title shown in Mint; Mint derives one from the prompt when omitted.

generationMode.description: Workflow behavior. auto is the default and continues to the final asset; review pauses at Preview for approval or revision. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier; Mint selects the underlying generation model.

imageUrl.description: One public HTTPS reference image for visual guidance; do not combine with sourceImages.

sourceImages.description: Two to eight public HTTPS reference images used together for visual guidance; do not combine with imageUrl.

prompt.description: Describe the 3D Model Mint should create.

name.description: Optional 3D Model title shown in Mint; Mint derives one from the prompt when omitted.

generationMode.description: Workflow behavior. auto is the default and continues to the final asset; review pauses at Preview for approval or revision. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier; Mint selects the underlying generation model.

imageUrl.description: One public HTTPS reference image for visual guidance; do not combine with sourceImages.

sourceImages.description: Two to eight public HTTPS reference images, such as alternate views of one object; do not combine with imageUrl.

riggingPose.description: Prepare a humanoid character Preview in the selected neutral pose with a front-facing full-body view and empty hands. This does not rig or animate the model.

AssetPackGenerationRequest.description: A natural-language request for a coordinated Asset Pack. Mint plans the individual assets and shared visual direction.

prompt.description: Describe the pack in natural language, including its purpose, desired assets, count, or style when relevant. Example: Create 4 assets for a sci-fi game pack.

name.description: Optional Asset Pack title shown in Mint; Mint derives one from the prompt when omitted.

generationMode.description: Workflow behavior. auto is the default and continues to final assets; review pauses at Preview for approval or revision. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier applied across the pack.

imageUrl.description: One public HTTPS reference image shared by the pack; do not combine with sourceImages.

sourceImages.description: Two to eight public HTTPS reference images available to pack items; do not combine with imageUrl.

assetPackType.description: Optional category override. Mint otherwise infers the best category from the prompt and falls back to general_asset_pack when no specialized category fits.

itemCount.description: Optional exact number of assets to create. If omitted, Mint follows a count in the prompt; if the prompt has no count, Mint creates 8 assets.

styleGuide.example: Low-poly sci-fi props with cool gray metal, cyan accents, and soft studio lighting
styleGuide.description: Optional visual-direction override shared by every asset. Mint infers this from the prompt when omitted.

riggingPose.description: Prepare humanoid character items in the selected neutral pose for later rigging; this does not rig or animate them.

prompt.description: Describe the surface and texture maps Mint should create.

name.description: Optional Material title shown in Mint; Mint derives one from the prompt when omitted.

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier for Material generation.

imageUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS image used as the Material source.

mode.description: How Mint should create or derive the Material maps.

MaterialPackGenerationRequest.description: Instructions for creating a coordinated Material Pack.

prompt.description: Describe the shared purpose of the Material Pack.

name.description: Optional Material Pack title shown in Mint; Mint derives one when omitted.

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier applied across the pack.

imageUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS image shared as source context.

mode.description: How Mint should create or derive the Material maps.

itemCount.description: Number of requested Materials; when supplied, it must equal the items array length.

styleGuide.description: Optional visual rules shared by every Material in the pack.

items.description: The individual Materials Mint should create.

label.description: Short human-readable label for this Material.

prompt.description: Material-specific generation instructions.
Describe the Image Mint should create.

name.description: Optional Image title shown in Mint; Mint derives one from the prompt when omitted.

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier for Image generation.

VideoGenerationRequest.description: Create a final video directly. References are owned Mint reference asset IDs; mode and reference limits are validated before paid generation.

durationSeconds.description: Whole seconds within the selected preset's supported range. Defaults to a sole video reference's duration, rounded to whole seconds, or 8 seconds. Supply explicitly when using multiple video references.

aspectRatio.description: Image and first/last-frame modes follow the start image in every preset. Its landscape/portrait orientation must match this setting; reframe the image before submitting to change orientation. Exact output dimensions are reported on completion.

AudioGenerationRequest.description: Instructions for creating one Audio asset.

prompt.description: Describe the sound, ambience, or music Mint should create.

name.description: Optional Audio title shown in Mint; Mint derives one from the prompt when omitted.

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier for Audio generation.

audioKind.description: Whether to create a short sound effect or general Audio.

durationSeconds.description: Requested Audio duration in seconds, up to five minutes.

ImageEditRequest.description: Instructions for creating a non-destructive Image edit.

editInstruction.description: Describe the change Mint should apply to the source Image.

name.description: Optional title for the new edited Image.

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier for the Image edit.

ReferenceImageUploadRequest.description: Import one reusable reference image from a public URL or base64 data.

sourceUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL to the image; do not combine with base64Data.

base64Data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes; requires fileName and contentType.

fileName.description: Original file name for a base64 upload.

contentType.description: Image MIME type for a base64 upload.

name.description: Optional reference image title shown in Mint.

AssetPackApproveRequest.description: Optionally select Asset Pack Preview items to approve; omit the body to approve all eligible items.

itemIds.description: Asset Pack item IDs to approve; omit to approve every eligible item.

WorldReviseRequest.description: Instructions for revising a World Preview.

feedback.description: Describe the changes Mint should make to the Preview.

generationMode.description: auto continues after the revised Preview; review pauses again for another decision. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

name.description: Optional replacement title for the World.

revisionEditStrength.description: How broadly Mint may change the existing Preview.

ModelReviseRequest.description: Instructions for revising a 3D Model Preview.

feedback.description: Describe the changes Mint should make to the Preview.

generationMode.description: auto continues after the revised Preview; review pauses again for another decision. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

name.description: Optional replacement title for the 3D Model.

revisionEditStrength.description: How broadly Mint may change the existing Preview.

riggingPose.description: Prepare the revised humanoid Preview in the selected neutral pose for later rigging.

AssetPackReviseRequest.description: Instructions for revising all or selected Asset Pack Previews.

feedback.description: Describe the changes Mint should make to the selected Previews.

generationMode.description: auto continues after revised Previews; review pauses again for another decision. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

scope.description: Whether the revision applies to every item or selected item IDs.

itemIds.description: Required when scope is items; ignored for all_items.

name.description: Optional replacement title for the Asset Pack.

revisionEditStrength.description: How broadly Mint may change the selected Previews.

riggingPose.description: Prepare revised humanoid character items in the selected neutral pose for later rigging.

GenerationRetryRequest.description: Optional overrides when retrying a failed World or 3D Model generation.

prompt.description: Replacement prompt; required when the prior failure requires prompt changes.

name.description: Optional title for the new retried asset.

generationMode.description: Workflow behavior for the retried generation. auto is the default; review pauses at Preview. See [Preview-based generation](https://docs.mint.gg/developers/api-overview#preview-based-generation).

generationPreset.description: Quality, speed, and cost tier for the retry.

AssetPackRetryRequest.description: Optionally select failed Asset Pack Preview items to retry.

itemIds.description: Failed item IDs to retry; omit to retry every eligible item.

ModelRetopologyRequest.description: Optional settings for creating a retopologized copy of a Mint 3D Model.

polygonType.description: Mesh topology to create; quadrilateral topology is currently supported.

faceLevel.description: Target mesh detail level for the retopologized copy.

name.description: Optional title for the retopologized 3D Model shown in Mint.

ModelAnimationRequest.description: Animation selection and optional sizing for one eligible Mint 3D Model.

animationSetId.description: Stable curated set ID from GET /v1/animation-sets. Include animationActionIds to select a subset of that set.

motionPrompt.description: Describe the motion Mint should select; do not combine with animationSetId.

animationActionIds.description: Optional subset of curated action IDs from the selected animationSetId.

heightMeters.description: Character height in meters used to scale the animation result.

AssetPackAnimationRequest.description: Animation selection and optional item targeting for eligible 3D Models in a Mint Asset Pack.

animationSetId.description: Stable curated set ID from GET /v1/animation-sets. Include animationActionIds to select a subset of that set.

motionPrompt.description: Describe the motion Mint should select; do not combine with animationSetId.

animationActionIds.description: Optional subset of curated action IDs from the selected animationSetId.

heightMeters.description: Character height in meters used to scale the animation result.

scope.description: Animate all eligible Asset Pack items or only the IDs in itemIds.

itemIds.description: Asset Pack item IDs to animate when scope is items.

ArtifactManifestBatchRequest.description: Assets whose downloadable artifact manifests should be returned together.

assets.description: One to 25 Mint-owned assets to resolve.

id.description: Mint asset ID owned by the authenticated account.

feedback.description: Describe the changes Mint should make to the current Preview.

ModelOptimizationRequest.description: Optional settings for creating an optimized copy of a Mint 3D Model.

optimizationLevel.description: Optimization intensity. light preserves more detail, moderate is the default balance, and aggressive reduces file size most.

ModelConversionRequest.description: Choose the downloadable formats Mint should create from this 3D Model.

targetFormats.description: Output formats to create. Duplicate values are ignored.

name.description: Optional title used for the conversion output and exported files.
